titulo: Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026: The biggest announcements and trailers
cuerpo: The Geoff Keighley-hosted Opening Night Live event at Gamescom just wrapped up. Arguably the biggest announcement was the closer: a remastered version of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt from CD Projekt Red that’s launching in September.
